items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: I played with him about three years. But it wasn't his band, it was Lewis the Man's band.

ctx.x: When you were about 12 years old, you have here on the sheet. A sheet of paper. What about August Roussel?

What about August Roussel? August Roussel used to play with us too. He was a tambour player. He was a good leader too, but sometimes he used to make mistakes and Lewis the Man, he used to get after him all the time, you know. I played with him about three years. But it wasn't his band, it was Lewis the Man's band. And we had Gus Muscapper and Robert Hall. You heard talking about Robert Hall? Edward Hall's brother. We had a line up like that. We had Henry Rush with us once. When he quit, we had Joe Stratton. You…
Slide whistle, you mean? Yeah. And Henry Rush was playing drums at the time?

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: Me and Louie and George used to play with Kit Harris.

ctx.x: He played just there. Kit Harris? Who was him? Huh? Kit Harris, I didn't know him. No, you didn't know Kit Harris? No, he did too, Kit Harris. Yeah, trumpet, yeah. Me and Louie and George used to play with Kit Harris. He's a good trampone player, Louie Nelson did.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: My dear George worked- worked with me more than any band ever worked with... And I got him George Lewis... We played with him.

ctx.x: How long has he been dead? How long has he been dead? My brother must be dead about, um.

You see, my belly, my belly, I'm saying. See, time passed up, but my belly been dead about 23 years. I think Bud died before him. That's why his niece was two years old when my belly died. My brother died, George. You remember my brother George? He was a psycho. He wasn't much a musician, but he was, you know, make out sometimes, you know. He'd take a chance anyway, you know. Just better work, too. Yeah, I was all them boys. Lee Collins and, um, Lee Collins and, uh, Kid Rene. Oh, Bud Appetite. They all used to go…
Did you play with Bud before he was with the Liberty Bell or after?

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: George used to hire different police... I'd work with him once or twice... But he paid me off good.

ctx.x: Ask him when you worked at the Absinthe House.

When did you work at the Absinthe House? It was six. That's when I went to Emris Wright. That's when I told you that me and T-Ball was the darkest man in the band. And the purist man hired his one. They don't make no price with you. They take up collections. If you make a price with them, they give you what the price is. But if you come on just for the kid, sometimes they make $20, $25, $30 a man. But if you tell him $10 a man, they give you $10. Then they come and show you they have about $160 over. And so see…
Yeah. He sang all that and that.
